name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd.
about: Gallantt Ispat Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of steel and steel products in India. The company offers pellets, sponge iron, MS billets, and TMT bars; and MIS roll bars, iron ore pellets, and other products. It also provides ordinary portland, portland pozzolana, rapid hardening, sulphate-resistant, white, low-heat, and blended cement. In addition, the company is involved in real estate business; and power generation business. The company sells its products through network of dealers, distributors, directly to the bulk buyers, and participates in auctions of government and non-government organizations. It serves real estate developers, construction industries, government organizations, and corporate.
